''See also: [[Cynara Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Cynara is a royal figure who was once intended to ascend to the [[throne]]. She is the sister of [[Leah]] and possesses a sharp intellect along with a strong, driven nature. Her history includes a period of being held underground and an experience in [[Asphodel]] where she suffered extreme agony while being consumed by a [[Tree]]. This event left her in a state of paranoia and delusion, causing her to remain confined within her palace rooms. As the original commissioner of the palace, she designed the [[Blue Room]] specifically to provide a visual reprieve for returning Ragnarus Traveler{{!}}Ragnarus Travelers. Despite her diminished power, she remains an active participant in negotiations and possesses access to the [[Crimson Vault]], from which she can retrieve items such as the [[Rod of Harmony]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Cynara manifests in a flash of red. Her dress is composed entirely of scarlet light.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|She is described as mad, suffering from delusions and paranoia. This state has left her trapped within the rooms of her palace.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|In an effort to halt [[Rhalia]]'s rampage, Cynara sought out dark weapons. She was later seen sitting upon a carved wooden [[throne]] located within the antechamber of Ragnarus the Crimson Vault{{!}}Ragnarus. Although [[Leah]] identifies her as an insane sister, Cynara eventually made a sudden appearance in a flash of red. During this manifestation, her dress was composed entirely of scarlet light.}}
